criteria.statement: SoulFactory app-level configuration is additive and disabled by default.
Enabled SoulFactory config requires explicit relays, authorized requester pubkeys, a real Signet bunker URI, and explicit LLM endpoint/model/key settings.
App construction does not build a SoulFactory signer, OpenClaw runtime adapter, reactor, or background runner when soul_factory.enabled=false.
App construction with valid enabled config builds the SoulFactory reactor, FullProvisioner, and OpenClaw runtime adapter and registers the reactor runner without enabling Signet mock mode.
Invalid enabled SoulFactory config fails deterministically before production Signet/runtime construction.
The Item 1 slice does not add REST SoulFactory provisioning or lifecycle routes.
Provisioning status, error result, success result, and final read-model publications target the normalized primary/additional relay set and propagate publish failures.
The OpenClaw runtime result is returned to the provisioner and applied to the soul before the final 31951 read model and terminal 7950 success result are published.
Bahia service projection does not create synthetic deployable artifacts or deployment intents; deployment intent creation requires explicit opt-in plus runtime artifact metadata containing a digest.
